LanguageData.WotF_FeyAncestry.label: fey ancestry
LanguageData.WotF_FeyAncestry.description: A long-lived fey heritage free from age-related chronic disease. After age 20, shorter-lived races age more slowly toward a natural lifespan of roughly 500 years. Meditation restores rest at 90% effectiveness plus the strength of its focus. An assigned meditation spot or trance cushion satisfies the colonist bed requirement.
